name: Three-Way Melee
description: Three rivals, one city, one prize. Metropolis is the densest market on the map and everyone wants the soft-drink aisle. Become the top brand, hold a commanding share, and prove it isn't a fluke by stringing together a year of consecutive profits.

goals.description: Reach 75 brand awareness for soft drink in Metropolis — outshine all three rivals at the top of mind.
Hold 40% share of soft drink in Metropolis — a plurality in a four-horse race.
Post 12 consecutive months of positive net income — a brawl is one thing, sustaining it is another.
Grow corporate value to $55M — spoils worthy of winning the melee.
